articles.summary: Bumble Shareholders to Receive $6.05 Per Share in Cash Representing a 138% Premium to the Unaffected Share Price Bumble Inc. (NASDAQ: BMBL) (“Bumble” or “the Company”) today announced that it entered into a definitive agreement to be acquired by Ithaca Holdings (“Ithaca”) in an all-cash transaction valuing the Company at $1.3 billion. Under the terms of the agreement, Bumble common shareholders will receive cash consideration of $6.05 per share of Class A Common Stock, representing an approximately 138% premium to the unaffected closing share price on October 9, 2026, and a premium of approximately 119% to the 30-day volume weighted average price as of October 9, 2026. Transaction Details An independent Special Committee of Bumble’s Board of Directors (“Special Committee”), advised by independent legal and financial advisors, conducted a rigorous process to evaluate a range of strategic alternatives.
